create_m2m100_config: create a M2M100Config instance with default settings for the facebook/m2m100_418M model
build_m2m100_model: build a M2M100Model with random weights using a M2M100Config instance
access_model_config: access the model configuration from a M2M100Model instance via model.config
configure_m2m100_encoder: configure M2M100Config with custom encoder_layers, encoder_attention_heads, and encoder_ffn_dim values
configure_m2m100_decoder: configure M2M100Config with custom decoder_layers, decoder_attention_heads, and decoder_ffn_dim values
